privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Ūrdhv Ascens is committed to absolute data transparency and responsible privacy practices.

sections.heading: 1. Scope and Commitment
sections.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Ūrdhv Ascens ('we', 'us', 'our') collects, uses, and safeguards information when you visit our website or access our free educational course booklets through the Ūrdhv Ascens Viewer platform.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content:
When entering our educational learning courses, we request your name, contact information (email or phone number), role (Student, Educator, Professional), and optional institutional affiliation. We collect this data strictly on an opt-in basis with your explicit consent checkbox.

We additionally log cryptographic hashes of incoming IP addresses (SHA-256 salted) to prevent automated rate-limit abuse and safeguard edge CDN bandwidth. We do not store raw IP addresses alongside personal identities.

sections.heading: 3. Educational Booklet Access
sections.content: All course booklets are completely free of charge. We do not process payments, collect banking details, or request payment card credentials for curriculum access.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Edge Delivery
sections.content: Booklet pages and static visual assets are served across high-performance edge content delivery networks (Cloudflare Pages and Hostinger edge infrastructure). No tracking pixels or third-party behavioral analytics monitors are embedded into our reader canvas.

sections.heading: 5. Contact & Data Deletion
sections.content: To request inspection or complete deletion of your reader record, contact our data administration desk at urdhvascens@gmail.com. Inquiries are handled promptly within standard business response windows.
